content:
jordan-newhire: hey team — hitting a block on my first login. Okta says 'Device not managed' and won't let me finish SSO. this is a company Macbook assigned in the offer letter. who do i ping?

devex_sam: welcome! :wave: usually that's Jamf device trust. Did you enroll the laptop in Jamf during setup? link: https://intranet.redwood/jamf-enroll

jordan-newhire: followed the doc and ran the profile install, but Okta still shows unmanaged. i restarted. no MDM profile under System Settings > Profiles.

jamf_admin: can you share the Mac serial (or DM it) so I can check DEP/Inventory? sometimes asset wasn't imported into DEP from procurement.

jordan-newhire: serial is C02XYZ1234G — dm-ing it now.

it_support_bot: Ticket created: #IT-4582 — "Okta device trust failing for C02XYZ1234G". Assigned to jamf_admin. Status: open.

jamf_admin: checked — device serial not in DEP and not in Jamf inventory. Looks like it missed the procurement sync. I can add it manually but that'll take ~1-2h and may require a reboot for MDM to push.

devex_sam: short-term options: 1) enroll a personal device (phone/laptop) to complete SSO, or 2) i can issue a 24h Okta bypass so you can finish onboarding and get accounts set up. which do you prefer?

jordan-newhire: i'll use my phone for now to get access to 1password and google workspace. if you can do the 24h bypass that would be great so i can switch the mac later.

monica-peopleops: looping in people ops for procurement trace — we'll check order records and prevent future misses. tagging @jamf_admin to update ticket when inventory is fixed. :+1:

jamf_admin: noted. I'll add device to Jamf and push the profile. Jordan, once I mark it ready you'll get a Jamf prompt; follow the enroll doc and then Okta should mark it managed. I'll update #IT-4582 when done.

jordan-newhire: thanks everyone — saved me. cc'ing devex if i run into SSH key setup after access. :relieved:

devex_sam: anytime — if you need help with SSH or 1password CLI, ping me in DMs or post here. example SSH steps we use: `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "your.email@redwood.com"` then add public key to your profile.

it_support_bot: Update: #IT-4582 changed status to in_progress (jamf_admin).

jamf_admin: update: device added to Jamf inventory and enrollment profile queued. please reboot and look for the Jamf prompt.

jordan-newhire: rebooted — saw the Jamf prompt, installed profile, and Okta now shows managed. SSO succeeded. thanks all! :tada:

it_support_bot: #IT-4582 resolved. If anything else pops up, reopen the ticket or ping @jamf_admin.
